other_conditions: Must be a resident of Assam.
Film project must be in Assamese language or any other recognized regional language of Assam.
Filmmaker must have valid registration with the appropriate film bodies or associations.
Applicant must have a bank account in a recognized Indian bank.
Film project must have a well-developed script and compelling storyline.
Applicant must demonstrate feasibility and commercial viability of the project.
Project must have a clear budget and financial plan.
Filmmakers may be required to fulfill specific reporting and documentation requirements as per the scheme's guidelines.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance at various stages of film production for feature films and documentaries, along with professional guidance and industry exposure.
